questions.question: In which year was the pump installed whose seal change the site engineer came to plan in the week of 9 June 2025?

chunks.quote: Wed: Tomasz Wren visited to plan the seal change on HP40-2291 and asked for the old seal to be kept.

questions.note: The shift notes name the pump; only the pump record gives its installation year. The other Hydra P-40, HP40-1183, was installed in 2012.

questions.question: In which year did the person who kept the Brackwater fen field log start at the institute?

chunks.quote: Brackwater fen field log, spring 2025, kept by S. Osei.

questions.note: The log names him S. Osei; the staff record of Samuel Osei, the only Osei in the corpus, gives the start year.

questions.question: How many times in total do the documents report pump KV12-0457 tripping on low suction pressure?

chunks.quote: The station's only pump, KV12-0457, tripped three times in the first week of May on low suction pressure.
Wed: the Kestrel V-12 at Harbour Station (serial KV12-0457) tripped twice on low suction pressure

questions.note: Three trips in early May and two in the week of 7 April are different events. The June alarm after which KV12-0457 restarted on its own gives no cause, so it is not counted.

questions.question: How many projects in Riverton's 2025 and 2026 works budgets, taken together, cost less than 100,000 pounds?

chunks.quote: Mill Lane footbridge east railing: 15,000 pounds

questions.note: A project is counted once per budget line. In 2026 the carried-over Harbour Street resurfacing costs 110,000 pounds, so only its 2025 line counts.

questions.question: Which pumps were installed after 2015?
questions.sql: SELECT serial_number FROM pumps WHERE install_year > 2015

questions.question: Which institute teams have a member who started in 2020 or later?
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT team FROM staff WHERE start_year >= 2020
questions.note: Maria Lopez (S-104, Soil Ecology) started in 2021 and Samuel Osei (Hydrology) in 2023; the Finance Office's Maria Lopez started in 2016.

questions.question: Where did the Maria Lopez who runs a bakery train?

chunks.quote: Maria Lopez has opened a bakery at 14 Harbour Street, in the former post office. She trained in Valencia

questions.note: The two institute staff called Maria Lopez (the Soil Ecology researcher and the grants accountant) are other people; Utrecht, where the researcher went to a conference, is a wrong answer.

questions.question: What flow in litres per second did pump HP40-2291 deliver at the March 2025 inspection?
questions.note: The same report gives 38 for HP40-1183; the June inspection gives 39 for HP40-2291 and 40 for HP40-1183; the rated flow of both is 42.

questions.question: Did the sediment flume run above 60 litres per second in May 2025?

expected.text: No. No run went above 60 litres per second in May, because the committee had asked for a vibration measurement first.

chunks.quote: No run went above 60 litres per second in May: the committee had asked for a vibration measurement first.

questions.note: The text denies such runs. The 9 June minutes allow experiments above 60 litres per second only from then on; the first run on 20 May was at 40 litres per second. The reason may be left out.

questions.question: According to the mayor, by how many pounds did the Mill Lane footbridge works come in under budget?

chunks.quote: said the works had come in 12,000 pounds under budget

questions.note: The 2025 budget line of 180,000 pounds is the budget, not the saving.
